For a while I used other pet boarding services for Joe 🐶 and Cheetara 🐱, but there was always a feeling that something was missing; we always had some problem.

Until we discovered Campo Belo. We first started taking Joe there and felt safe the first time we arrived, seeing the double gate at the entrance, in addition to the gate for the pet area.

We also liked the service, all the attention, care, and the routine of photos and videos in the group, as well as all the affection always shown to him.

And after a final problem at our cat Cheetara's previous boarding facility, we were happy to find out that Campo Belo also had a dedicated space for cats, and a space infinitely better than the other boarding facility – spacious, airy, and always with lots of playtime and affection for her.

It was several years without any problems, and the biggest proof was always Joe's joy when he grabbed his little backpack to go to Campo Belo.

Joe and Cheetara are now together in furry heaven 🥲 and we are grateful to have had Campo Belo as our support every time we needed to board them.

Thank you to the entire team for all these years, I wish you all the best and much success to Campo Belo.

Nowadays, when looking for a dog hotel, I consider it essential that the place has 24-hour camera monitoring. This transparency should be standard in all establishments that receive animals for boarding.
I take my pets for bathing and grooming in places with glass walls and visual monitoring throughout the procedure, which gives me peace of mind and security. I would never accept videos or photos being sent; it doesn't make sense.
Similarly, I would never leave my pets in an environment without this type of technology, which is essential to ensure the well-being of the animals, prevent problems, and convey confidence to the owners.
For me, true care begins with transparency.

Fantastic place... I've left my pet at other pet hotels before, but nothing compares to Campo Belo. The facilities are excellent, and the attention and care the staff gives our puppy is incredible. I recommend it 10 stars.
